search_scope.result: Five official plugin source repositories are now verified and pinned. Twelve plugin identities remain NOT_IDENTIFIED at GitHub-source level. Two explicitly referenced repositories remain CANDIDATE_INCOMPLETE: Photo-Fixer (minimal README/LICENSE only) and PVEE's CL-VAEPPC pointer (legacy README/LICENSE/empty marker only). A.S.F.R.E.E Legacy is redirect-only. Similar-name repositories and upstream datasets are not promoted to canonical source without matching provenance and a complete source tree.
search_scope.classification_rule: A name-similar repository, search result owned by another account, prototype or mirror is not accepted as canonical without identity, provenance, manifest, license and source-history evidence.
